metadata.title: No Bake Nutella Cheesecake | One Pot Chef
metadata.description:
ONE POT CHEF COOKBOOKS ON iTUNES BOOKSTORE:
http://itunes.apple.com/au/artist/david-chilcott/id478668534?mt=11

No Bake Nutella Cheesecake is a decadent dessert that takes only moments to prepare. Cream Cheese is combined with sugar and Nutella, then gently spread over a crushed cookie crust and chilled until set. This rich, chocolate / hazelnut cheesecake will have everyone talking - give it a go!

ONE POT CHEF COOKBOOKS - PAPERBACKS AND EBOOKS:
http://www.lulu.com/spotlight/onepotchef

MY SECOND CHANNEL:
http://www.youtube.com/onepotchefblog

PLEASE SUBSCRIBE!
http://au.youtube.com/subscription_center?add_user=OnePotChefShow

FOLLOW ME ON TWITTER
http://www.twitter.com/onepotchef

BECOME A FAN ON FACEBOOK
http://www.facebook.com/onepotchef

FOLLOW ME ON GOOGLE+
http://gplus.to/onepotchef

=================
RECIPE FACT SHEET
=================

INGREDIENTS IN THIS DISH:

250g of Plain Sweet Cookies (Graham Crackers / Digestives etc)
100g of Butter
400g Jar of Nutella (Chocolate Hazelnut Spread)
500g of Cream Cheese (at room temperature)
1/2 Cup of Icing Sugar / Powdered Sugar (about 70g)


Preparation Time:  About 15 minutes
Chilling Time: About 4 - 5 hours


ALL MEASUREMENTS GIVEN ARE AUSTRALIAN STANDARD METRIC
(Look up Google for a conversion chart if using Imperial)

More cooking videos at:
http://www.onepotchefshow.com

"Bright Wish" and "Peppy Pepe"
by Kevin MacLeod

summary.brief: A chef in an apron makes a no‑bake Nutella cheesecake, from crust to chilled slice.
summary.detailed: The presenter melts butter with a tablespoon of Nutella in the microwave, then crushes plain sweet cookies and mixes them into the melted butter‑Nutella blend to form a crumbly crust. He presses the crust into a 22 cm spring‑form pan, smooths it, and chills it while preparing the filling. He beats softened cream cheese with icing sugar until smooth, folds in the remaining Nutella, and spreads this creamy mixture over the set crust. The assembled cheesecake is refrigerated for several hours until firm, then sliced, tasted, and the video ends with on‑screen text urging viewers to “thumbs up” and subscribe.

action.detailed: Melt butter with a tablespoon of Nutella, crush cookies and combine them with the melted mixture to form a crust, press the crust into a spring‑form pan and chill; beat cream cheese with icing sugar, fold in the remaining Nutella, spread the filling over the chilled crust, refrigerate until set, then slice and serve.

summary.brief: A no‑bake Nutella cheesecake is assembled by making a butter‑cookie crust and a creamy Nutella‑cream‑cheese filling.
summary.detailed: The chef chops 100 g of butter, adds a tablespoon of Nutella and microwaves the mixture until melted. He blends this with 250 g of crushed plain sweet cookies until the texture resembles wet sand, then presses the crumb mixture into the bottom and up the sides of a 22 cm spring‑form pan and chills it. While the crust chills, he beats 500 g of softened cream cheese with about 70 g of icing sugar until fluffy, folds the remaining Nutella from the 400 g jar into the cream‑cheese mixture and mixes until smooth. He spreads the creamy filling over the chilled crust, smooths the surface and declares the cheesecake ready to be refrigerated.
